title: Cold Focus
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental deep tech house, minimal, no vocals. Rolling dubby bassline, tight kick, crisp shuffled hats, shakers and woodblock, short Rhodes chord stabs with tape delay, soft filtered pads, subtle percussion fills. Calm, focused, hypnotic, deep work. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.

title: Soft Ledger
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental organic house, deep house, no vocals. Nylon guitar licks, marimba and kalimba notes, congas and bongos, shakers, warm bassline, soft kick, airy pads. Sunset terrace, warm and natural. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.

title: Corner Compound
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: Instrumental piano deep house, no vocals. Jazzy piano chords and a lyrical piano lead, soft organ pad, warm bass, laid-back kick, swung hats, gentle claps, a distant muted jazz trumpet adds a few soft phrases. Golden hour, confident. Evolving arrangement: filtered intro, chords and lead enter gradually, a breakdown without kick, then a fuller groove; the melody develops instead of looping. Hi-fi studio mix, warm and clean. Instrumental only.
